question: A loop of five chords, two beats each, runs in 4/4 under four-bar phrases. After how many bars do they realign?
move: When two cycles differ, count both in the smallest shared unit first.
trap: Multiplying the cycles, 10 x 16 beats, and landing on 40 bars.
hint: Measure both cycles in beats before looking for where they meet.
steps: They meet at the lowest common multiple of 10 and 16: 80 beats.
reference: Hardy & Wright, An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers, Oxford University Press, 2008
